title: DBOM New Orleans Jazz Museum Indoor/Outdoor Cafe
short_description: DBOM procurement for a café at the New Orleans Jazz Museum with operations and maintenance.
project_location: New Orleans Jazz Museum at the Old U.S. Mint, 400 Esplanade Ave, New Orleans, Louisiana 70116, USA
project_scope: Design, build, furnish, operate, and maintain a high-quality indoor/outdoor café at the New Orleans Jazz Museum, with an option to provide non-exclusive catering services. Contract structure indicates a 60-month base period with a 120-month renewal option.
services: Design-build-developer services including design, construction, furnishing, operations, maintenance, and optional non-exclusive catering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a café fit-out/operations concession rather than a structurally demanding engineering project.
- No indication of bridge, long-span roof, special structure, stadium, or complex building structure scope.
- Includes design-build responsibilities, but the tender focus is on full DBOM operation and maintenance.
- Limited apparent relevance to sbp's core expertise in lightweight structures, bridges, and special structural engineering.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. The notice only describes a DBOM café project at the museum and gives contract duration information; no area, structural scope, or cost basis is provided for a realistic estimate.
fee_explanation: No planning fee is stated in the source. Because the procurement combines design, construction, furnishing, operation, and maintenance, no separate engineering fee for sbp can be derived realistically from the available information.
